name: boto3
description: Boto3 is a Python library for interacting with AWS services. It provides a local-first alternative to boto3, allowing developers to build efficient and scalable applications without relying on cloud infrastructure.
rationale: The lack of a lightweight, open-source, and easy-to-use AWS client library in Python makes boto3 an ideal choice for building performance monitoring tools that require minimal cloud integration.
test_criteria: All unit tests must pass (pytest exit 0)
No hardcoded secrets or credentials in source
